newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to down 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to down 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent per lb weaker on Thursday, as prices are expected to correct from recent gains.
Wednesday, July closed at 11.15 cents per lb, up 0.10 cents, having ranged from 11.17 to 11.07 cents. The outer months finished 0.08 and 0.06 cent firmer.
Resistance was pegged at 11.20 cents basis July, where buy stops are believed to be resting. Producer selling is expected block gains, however.

LIFFE white sugar futures were lower on Thursday amid light profit-taking. At 0850 EDT/1250 GMT, the benchmark August contract stood $0.40 weaker at $321.00, while the rest of the board was $0.80 lower to $0.20 higher.
